scope: Calgary-informed student browsing collections; minimum two geometrically/programmatically distinct placeable choices per asset collection
assumptions: Architectural styles remain filters, not separate quotas.
Custom building ideas is an import/design workflow, not a fixed-asset collection; its two placeholders do not count as finished models.
The broad civic collection has two total choices in this first pass, not two of every school, hospital and arena subtype.
Existing extra reviewed assets are retained; no need to build every reference image.
Candidate labels and pair differences are nominations, subject to exact source review.

excluded_navigation_groups.reason: Two custom/prompt placeholders; preserve the workflow, do not count placeholders as models.

inventory_evidence.scope: Read-only inventory of the separate original checkout; not imported or promoted.

groups.label: Detached homes
groups.intended_distinction: Narrow contemporary two-storey home versus a low Craftsman bungalow with porch.

groups.label: Duplexes & semi-detached homes
groups.intended_distinction: Side-by-side infill versus stacked dwellings with an exterior stair; verify the chosen sources and component uses.

groups.label: Rowhouses & townhomes
groups.intended_distinction: Street-facing row of homes versus inward-facing courtyard housing; courtyard membership does not assert a legal dwelling count.

groups.label: Apartments
groups.intended_distinction: Compact mid-rise block versus a courtyard arrangement with shared outdoor space.

groups.label: Residential towers
groups.intended_distinction: Slender tower over a street-facing podium versus a slab tower with continuous balconies.

groups.label: Homes over shops & mixed use
groups.intended_distinction: Purpose-built mixed-use courtyard versus an industrial conversion; explicitly author component uses.

groups.label: Shops & services
groups.intended_distinction: Corner neighbourhood shop versus a single-storey multi-unit retail strip.

groups.label: Hotels & visitor accommodation
groups.intended_distinction: Urban corner hotel versus a lower lodge form.

groups.label: Offices
groups.intended_distinction: Compact urban office versus a lower campus arrangement.

groups.label: Schools, civic & recreation
groups.intended_distinction: Neighbourhood school versus a community recreation/gathering hall.

groups.label: Industry & warehouses
groups.intended_distinction: Gabled workshop/shed versus a larger tilt-wall warehouse and loading arrangement.

groups.label: Indoor farms & food production
groups.intended_distinction: Enclosed indoor grow building versus greenhouses above a warehouse; distinct forms rather than duplicate parent listings.

groups.label: Transit & utilities
groups.intended_distinction: Transit platform and shelter versus a civic energy/utility building; transit track/interface ownership is explicit.

groups.label: Pocket & sub-neighbourhood parks
groups.intended_distinction: Timber-and-gravel gathering pocket versus meadow-led pocket; qualify as distinct only if the source layouts and programmes differ.

groups.label: Neighbourhood & community parks
groups.intended_distinction: Rustic play-and-picnic loop versus a pastoral community park; source audit must establish a distinct layout/programme, not just planting.

groups.label: Regional & destination parks
groups.intended_distinction: Pastoral destination park versus an industrial-reuse destination landscape.

groups.label: Linear parks & green connections
groups.intended_distinction: Rail-trail greenway versus a river-edge greenway with different edge conditions.

groups.label: Natural areas & restoration
groups.intended_distinction: Native woodland structure versus open prairie restoration.

groups.label: Plazas & gathering places
groups.intended_distinction: Formal civic forecourt versus open market/event square.

groups.label: Play & sport amenities
groups.intended_distinction: Measured basketball court versus accessible-play concept with distinct equipment and circulation.

groups.label: Gardens & quiet spaces
groups.intended_distinction: Community food-growing plots versus a quiet ornamental garden.

groups.label: Waterfront & stormwater spaces
groups.intended_distinction: Wetland/rain-garden landscape versus a riparian promenade; hydrology remains a reported design assumption.

groups.label: Parking, special sites & custom spaces
groups.intended_distinction: Conventional parking court versus parking with planted drainage cells; no claim that either is a park.

groups.label: Local & residential streets
groups.intended_distinction: Draft figures 2 and 4: 16 m local versus 21 m high-activity local section.

groups.label: Collector streets
groups.intended_distinction: Draft figures 6 and 8: 20 m collector versus 27 m high-activity collector.

groups.label: Arterial & major streets
groups.intended_distinction: Draft figures 9 and 11: 33 m four-lane divided section versus 36 m high-activity section.

groups.label: Alleys & service lanes
groups.intended_distinction: Draft figure 1 alley versus a custom planted bioswale alley; do not invent a second Calgary manual standard.

groups.label: Walking, wheeling & shared streets
groups.intended_distinction: Shared green-corridor path versus a separated two-way cycle track with explicit street-edge interface.

groups.label: Transit corridors
groups.intended_distinction: Bus transit corridor versus a rail/tram avenue; different track/lane and stop geometry.

groups.label: Intersections & crossings
groups.intended_distinction: Protected corner-island intersection versus a compact single-lane roundabout.

groups.label: Traffic calming & safer streets
groups.intended_distinction: Planted curb extensions versus a raised crossing; authored network treatments rather than freestanding street pictures.

groups.label: Other streets & global inspiration
groups.intended_distinction: Urban main-street reference versus landscape-led parkway; custom design references, not certified Calgary sections.

inventory_evidence_scope: Original planning-time inventory; hashes are preserved baseline evidence, not a claim that subsequently edited files have these hashes.
